job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and secure APIs using Python and AWS services such as API Gateway, Lambda Functions, Step Functions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs.
Develop data validation rules using IAM Policies to ensure data integrity in Dynamo DB.
Troubleshoot issues related to VPC connectivity, SQS queues, CloudWatch metrics.

Job Requirements :

4-7 years of experience in software development with a focus on backend technologies like Python.
Strong understanding of generative AI concepts and their application in large language models.
Proficiency in developing RESTful APIs using Flask or Django frameworks.
Experience working with AWS services including API Gateway, Lambda Functions, Step Functions



Python: 

must-have: Basic fundamentals of python, Python Coding skills, APIs,

Good-to-have: Frameworks like Flask or Django knowledge

 

AWS: 

must-have: Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager,  VPC. 

Good-to-have: SageMaker, Batch, ECR, SNS, API Gateway, DLQ, networking, Terraform,

 

GenAI:

 

must-have: Bedrock, prompting, LLMs, chunking, validation, summarization.

 

Good-to-have: RAG, evaluation, guardrails, Mermaid, legacy modernization, code analysis, mainframe, Claude.
